observed.auction_observations.offered_amount_usd: Exact offered market supply in USD; not awards or actual GSD obligations
observed.observed_broad_mbsd_stock_usd: Latest reconciled MBSD chosen_usd; broad guarantee notional, not TBA-only or cash
observed.observed_top5_average_share: NSCC18.2.2 AverageInQuarter; stylized distribution compatibility only
observed.observed_top5_peak_share: Separate NSCC18.2.2 PeakInQuarter; not used as average or vice versa
observed.observed_top5_im_average_share: Separate margin aggregate; not same member group as top5positions

derived_from_observed.observed_daily_offered_usd: Sum actual offered amounts by unchanged issue_date
derived_from_observed.date: Fixed calendar days in selected observed month; not synthetic auction events

assumed_missing.conditional_obligation_usd: Offered supply times assumed participation/award-eligibility share and netting ratio; not observed GSD obligations
assumed_missing.opening_cash_usd/funding_received_usd: Unknown cash buffers, available funding amounts and funding delays
assumed_missing.assumed_tba_share/maturity_fraction/assu: Unobserved TBA component and maturity/delivery decomposition
assumed_missing.assumed_member_share/assumed_member_coun: Virtual average-compatible member distribution; not observed identities or daily/quarter-end weights
assumed_missing.normalized_exposure_units/hypothetical_a: Normalized total100, arbitrary add-on threshold/rate; not dollars or official margin

derived_from_observed_and_assumed_missin.primary_value: Conditional cash/stock/allocation consequences, not actual outcomes
derived_from_observed_and_assumed_missin.paid_usd/unpaid_usd/overdue_usd: Model ledger consequences after only missing link assumptions are applied
